blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Rear Adm. Jay Tarriela on Monday accused Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan of spreading disinformation, saying the Chinese Embassy in Manila appeared to mistake Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. for former Foreign Affairs Secretary Teodoro Locsin Jr. in its allegations over stalled joint oil and gas exploration talks. On Sunday, the Chinese Embassy posted on social media that Philippine-China oil and gas talks had fallen through after exploratory discussions were undermined, claiming that “if people like Teodoro had not sabotaged the process, we would have seen tangible results by now.” Tarriela dismissed the embassy’s allegations against […]...
